steps.title: Create the year's project

commands.note: or --country canada; then cd ~/taxes/2024

the year folders and their state

steps.why: One folder of exports for every year: inputs/<account>/ (each with a README.txt naming the export to download) shared by the year folders, each a complete project with its own taxjson.toml, ticker.map and holdings/.

steps.title: Make taxjson.toml match your accounts
steps.how: One [accounts.NAME] section per account you have (type = "taxable" or "sheltered"; crypto = true for Coinbase or Kraken), the others deleted; with a crypto account, [settings] local_timezone (e.g. "America/Toronto").
steps.why: Sheltered accounts count too: a purchase there can deny a loss in a taxable account. Crypto rows are dated in local_timezone.

steps.title: Each account's broker exports, through January of the next year

commands.note: recomputes the filed year from its inputs and shows any drift

steps.how: Filed: the books are the exports as they were at close-year; an export added now is an amendment.
steps.why: A sale's cost comes from its purchase, which may be years back; December trades settle in January.

steps.title: Each broker's exports reach the year end wherever it still holds positions

commands.note: its Warning names a broker whose exports stop while it holds positions
the broker had no later activity: answers the gaps shown

steps.why: A broker whose exports stop while it holds positions leaves its later sales, option expiries and income out of the books — nothing else says so.

steps.title: Retirement accounts' activity present
steps.how: Each IRA / Roth / 401(k) account's exports in its inputs/<account>/ folder too.
steps.why: An IRA/401(k) purchase within 30 days of a loss is a wash sale (Rev. Rul. 2008-5) — the loss is gone for good.

steps.title: Crypto ledgers and trades for the full year
steps.how: The Coinbase / Kraken ledgers and trade files for the whole year in the crypto account's inputs/<account>/.
steps.why: Every disposition of a coin, including swaps and fees, is a capital event.

record one

steps.why: A US project does not read tobase.map: two listings of one share are one position only through your ticker.map lines, a transfer journal or a .tt JOURNAL line (tax-logic US-XLIST-05).

every rename with its date and source

steps.why: A rename carries the position and its cost on its date; a later trade in the old ticker is another security unless ticker.map says otherwise.

steps.title: Anything no export holds: .tt lines

commands.note: every .tt line read as the run reads it, each problem named with its file and line
the books' rows in the same .tt format, to copy from

steps.how: A purchase from before your downloads, a dividend from a slip (Webull), a return of capital (ADJUST): a line in a .tt file in inputs/<account>/ (docs/settings.md, ".tt files"). Non-cash fund distributions go in [[distributions]] in taxjson.toml.
steps.why: The run reads a .tt file like a broker file; `tjs run --strict` refuses a line whose total is not quantity x price +/- fee.

steps.title: Nondividend distributions (1099-DIV box 3) entered before trusting any basis

commands.note: the year's return of capital per security, as the books hold it

steps.how: An ADJUST line in a .tt file, or [[distributions]] in taxjson.toml, per fund that published one (docs/tax-rules.md, "Non-cash and reinvested distributions"); then confirm with `tjs checklist --done roc-entered`.
steps.why: Return of capital reduces basis; funds often reclassify after year end.

steps.title: Start next year's project

commands.note: one folder of exports for every year: the next year's folder beside this one, with copies of this year's taxjson.toml and ticker.map
a single-folder project, first: makes it the year folder 2024/, its exports shared by every year (then `tjs new-year 2025`)
later, in the new year: the map lines and settings that differ, to bring over

steps.how: With shared exports the new year reads the same inputs/; new-year sets its prior_year_record to this year's lock. A single-folder project: `tjs migrate --to-years` first (`--dry-run` shows the plan), then `tjs new-year 2025` in 2024/. Then `tjs handoff` in the new year. Keep a broker positions snapshot taken at (or just after) the year end in this year's holdings/.
steps.why: Next year's cost comes from this year's books.
